map.白夜怎么定义？: How is a white night defined?
map.午夜太阳高度 > −6°（民用曙暮光），整夜不黑、无需照明；极昼期间同样计入白夜: Midnight sun altitude > −6° (civil twilight), not dark all night and no lighting needed; polar-day periods also count as white nights, so white nights outnumber polar days.
